title: Construct a URL with a path variable
instruction:
Define a function `build_user_url(user_id)` that takes a user ID (integer) and **returns** the full URL string in the format `https://api.example.com/users/{user_id}`.

Use an f-string to insert the user_id into the path.

title: Build a headers dictionary with Accept
instruction: Define a function `build_headers()` that **returns** a dictionary with the keys `Accept` (set to `application/json`) and `User-Agent` (set to `PythonRequests/1.0`).
test_suite:
def test_has_accept_key():
    result = exercise.build_headers()
    assert "Accept" in result, f"Key 'Accept' not found in headers: {result}"
    assert result["Accept"] == "application/json", f"Expected 'application/json', got {result['Accept']!r}"

def test_has_user_agent():
    result = exercise.build_headers()
    assert "User-Agent" in result, f"Key 'User-Agent' not found in headers: {result}"
    assert result["User-Agent"] == "PythonRequests/1.0", f"Expected 'PythonRequests/1.0', got {result['User-Agent']!r}"

def test_returns_dict():
    result = exercise.build_headers()
    assert isinstance(result, dict), f"Expected a dict, got {type(result).__name__}"

def test_has_exactly_two_keys():
    result = exercise.build_headers()
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 keys, got {len(result)}: {result}"

title: GET request with a path variable
instruction:
Define a function `build_jsonplaceholder_url(user_id)` that takes a user ID (integer) and **returns** the URL string `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/{user_id}`.

Use an f-string to insert the user_id into the path.

title: URL with multiple path variables
instruction:
Define a function `build_post_url(user_id, post_id)` that takes two integers and **returns** the URL string `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/{user_id}/posts/{post_id}`.

Use an f-string to insert both variables into the path.

title: POST request with JSON body
instruction:
Define a function `get_posts_url()` that returns the string `"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts"`.

Define a function `create_post_payload()` that **returns** a dictionary with the keys `title` ("My Post"), `body` ("Post content"), and `userId` (1).
test_suite:
def test_get_posts_url():
    result = exercise.get_posts_url()
    assert result == "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts", f"Expected posts URL, got {result!r}"

def test_create_post_payload_has_title():
    result = exercise.create_post_payload()
    assert "title" in result, f"Key 'title' not found: {result}"
    assert result["title"] == "My Post", f"Expected 'My Post', got {result['title']!r}"

def test_create_post_payload_has_body():
    result = exercise.create_post_payload()
    assert "body" in result, f"Key 'body' not found: {result}"
    assert result["body"] == "Post content", f"Expected 'Post content', got {result['body']!r}"

def test_create_post_payload_has_userId():
    result = exercise.create_post_payload()
    assert "userId" in result, f"Key 'userId' not found: {result}"
    assert result["userId"] == 1, f"Expected userId 1, got {result['userId']}"

def test_create_post_payload_returns_dict():
    result = exercise.create_post_payload()
    assert isinstance(result, dict), f"Expected a dict, got {type(result).__name__}"

title: GET request with Authorization header
instruction:

test_suite:

def test_returns_dict():
    result = exercise.build_auth_headers()
    assert isinstance(result, dict), f"Expected a dict, got {type(result).__name__}"

def test_has_exactly_two_keys():

    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 keys, got {len(result)}: {result}"

title: POST request with form data
instruction:
Define a function `get_form_post_url()` that returns the string `"https://httpbin.org/post"`.

Define a function `create_form_data()` that **returns** a dictionary with keys `username` ("alice") and `password` ("secret").

Remember: when using `data=` with `requests.post()`, the `Content-Type` header is automatically set to `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
test_suite:
def test_get_form_post_url():
    result = exercise.get_form_post_url()
    assert result == "https://httpbin.org/post", f"Expected 'https://httpbin.org/post', got {result!r}"

def test_create_form_data_has_username():
    result = exercise.create_form_data()
    assert "username" in result, f"Key 'username' not found: {result}"
    assert result["username"] == "alice", f"Expected 'alice', got {result['username']!r}"

def test_create_form_data_has_password():
    result = exercise.create_form_data()
    assert "password" in result, f"Key 'password' not found: {result}"
    assert result["password"] == "secret", f"Expected 'secret', got {result['password']!r}"

def test_create_form_data_returns_dict():
    result = exercise.create_form_data()
    assert isinstance(result, dict), f"Expected a dict, got {type(result).__name__}"

title: PUT request with path variable and headers
instruction:
Define a function `get_update_url(post_id)` that returns `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/{post_id}` using an f-string.

Define a function `get_update_headers()` that returns a dict with `Content-Type` and `Accept` both set to `"application/json"`.

Define a function `get_update_data()` that returns a dict with `id` (1), `title` ("Updated"), `body` ("Updated body"), and `userId` (1).
test_suite:
def test_get_update_url():
    result = exercise.get_update_url(1)
    assert result == "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1", f"Expected URL, got {result!r}"

def test_get_update_url_with_different_id():
    result = exercise.get_update_url(5)
    assert result == "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/5", f"Expected URL, got {result!r}"

def test_get_update_headers():
    result = exercise.get_update_headers()
    assert result["Content-Type"] == "application/json", f"Expected 'application/json', got {result.get('Content-Type')!r}"
    assert result["Accept"] == "application/json", f"Expected 'application/json', got {result.get('Accept')!r}"

def test_get_update_data():
    result = exercise.get_update_data()
    assert result["id"] == 1
    assert result["title"] == "Updated", f"Expected 'Updated', got {result['title']!r}"
    assert result["body"] == "Updated body", f"Expected 'Updated body', got {result['body']!r}"
    assert result["userId"] == 1
